title: Unveiling an ALS Blood Transcriptomic Signature: A Machine Learning Classifier Distinct from Neurodegenerative Controls
summary: The paper reports distinct cross-disease transcriptomic profiles and a linear ALS signature, with AUC 0.74 under external validation; nonlinear models overfit in validation.
ai_technology: LASSO logistic regression selects/regularizes genes from transcriptomic comparisons; tenfold stratified CV tunes predictive models, with SVM and Random Forest used as nonlinear comparators.
organization: LAGENBIO, Faculty of Veterinary, University of Zaragoza, Zaragoza, Spain; Centre for Biomedical Research, Neurodegenerative Diseases (CIBERNED), Madrid, Spain; Agroalimentary Institute of Aragon (IA2), University of Zaragoza, Zaragoza, Spain

evidence.tested: The paper reports distinct cross-disease transcriptomic profiles and a linear ALS signature, with AUC 0.74 under external validation; nonlinear models overfit in validation. Discovery and independent GEO cohorts were analyzed; ALS external validation includes GSE112680 (164 cases, 137 controls). The evidence is retrospective/public-data classification, not prospective clinical diagnostic validation; cohort/platform heterogeneity and non-ALS model instability limit interpretation.
evidence.unknown: not a clinically validated diagnostic test.
evidence.ai_role: LASSO logistic regression selects/regularizes genes from transcriptomic comparisons; tenfold stratified CV tunes predictive models, with SVM and Random Forest used as nonlinear comparators.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
